question: The inaugural Olympic Congress was organised in the year 1894 in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first Olympic Congress was held in Paris, France, in 1894.**
 
• It was** this Congress that founded and established the IOC.**
 
• The** process of revival of the Olympic Games also began at the Paris Congress of 1894.**
 
• **An Olympic Congress** is a **large gathering of representatives from the different constituencies of the Olympic Movement**, **organized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).​**
